verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a fraud-prevention SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only sending order data into Riskified and receiving per-order decisions or notifications; nothing documents a bulk export of account data in open formats or an offboarding path. Per-order decision notifications are an adjacent feature, not a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
